position.zh-Hant: 主張紐芬蘭依 1763 年的委任狀與公告只取得沿岸一條狹長地帶（提議以高潮線向內陸一英里為界），其餘的拉布拉多內陸屬加拿大（魁北克省）。出處：1927 年樞密院裁決書 pp. 9–10（A）；加拿大年鑑 1926 p. 1036（A，己方官方記載）。
position.en: Contended that Newfoundland held only a strip of coast under the Commission and Proclamation of 1763 (proposing a line one mile inland from high-water mark), the rest of the Labrador interior being Canadian (Quebec). Sources: Privy Council report of 1927, pp. 9–10 (grade A); Canada Year Book 1926, p. 1036 (grade A).

position.zh-Hant: 主張界線從安斯薩布隆向正北到北緯 52 度，再沿流入大西洋各河的分水嶺向北到奇德利角，也就是整個大西洋坡面的內陸都屬紐芬蘭。出處：1927 年樞密院裁決書 p. 10（A）。裁決結果大致採納這條分水嶺線（南段改沿北緯 52 度到羅曼河）。
position.en: Contended for a line due north from Ance Sablon to 52°N and thence northwards to Cape Chidley along the crest of the watershed of the rivers flowing into the Atlantic. Source: Privy Council report of 1927, p. 10 (grade A). The decision largely adopted this watershed line (with the southern section along the 52nd parallel to the Romaine river).

summary.zh-Hant: 拉布拉多半島內陸的歸屬。依裁決書，邊界問題最早在 1888 年前後提出，1903 年因紐芬蘭在漢密爾頓河一帶核發伐木許可而成為正式爭議，涉及超過 10 萬平方英里；雙方聲請交樞密院司法委員會裁決，1927-03-01 裁決大致採納紐芬蘭主張的分水嶺線。裁決以前兩方的主張並存，本系統不裁判當時誰有理。
summary.en: Ownership of the interior of the Labrador Peninsula. According to the report, the boundary question was first raised about 1888 and became a serious controversy in 1903 when Newfoundland licensed timber cutting near the Hamilton River; more than 100,000 square miles were affected. Referred to the Judicial Committee of the Privy Council, which on 1 March 1927 largely adopted the watershed line claimed by Newfoundland. Before the decision both claims stood side by side.
